services.title: First free service
services.detail: First Free Service is due on completion of 1,000 Km or 1 month (whichever comes first). To avail this offer, visit our authorized dealerships nearest to your location. This periodic maintenance is performed as per owner’s manual with no charges except any parts, lubricants and accessories (if consumed).

services.title: Second free service

This periodic maintenance is performed as per owner’s manual with no charges except any parts, lubricants and accessories (if consumed).

services.title: Third free service
services.detail: Third Free Service is due on completion of 10,000 Km or 6 months (whichever comes first). To avail this offer, visit our authorized dealerships nearest to your location. This periodic maintenance is performed as per owner’s manual with no charges except any parts, lubricants and accessories (if consumed).

warranty.intro: A written promise from Hyundai Nishat Motor Limited to repair or replace a component of vehicle that develops a fault due to material or workmanship within a fixed period of time.

blocks.heading: Warranty period
blocks.text: Any component, except the items specified hereafter, of your new Hyundai vehicle is covered for 48 months from the date of original retail delivery or date of first use, or 100,000 km, whichever occurs first.

blocks.heading: Paint warranty
blocks.text: Paint and surface corrosion warranty covers paint defects and/or other than perforation, such as cosmetic or surface corrosion due to defect in paint material or workmanship, for 24 months from the date of original retail delivery or date of first use, or 50,000 km, whichever comes first.

blocks.heading: OEM warranty
blocks.text: Tire, battery and audio navigation unit (AVN) are warranted by respective manufacturers, for details please see the related warranty condition card provided with the vehicle.

blocks.heading: Obtaining warranty service
blocks.text: Warranty services will be provided by authorized Hyundai distributor or dealers without charge for parts or labor. This warranty will not apply to the warranty service performed by those other than authorized Hyundai distributor or dealers.

blocks.heading: Judgment of warranty claims
blocks.text: Hyundai reserves the right to furnish final decision in warranty claims.

blocks.heading: Exclusion of all other warranty
blocks.text: This warranty is given in place of all other warranties expressed or implied, including any warranty of merchantability or fitness which extends beyond the express description herein, and any other obligations on the part of Hyundai or the selling dealer. No dealer or its agent or employee is authorized to extend or enlarge this warranty.

Repair or replacement of any component originally manufactured by Hyundai that is found to be defective in material or factory workmanship in normal use and maintenance, except any item specifically referred to in the section “What is not covered”.

blocks.heading: Normal maintenance
blocks.text: Including cleaning and polishing, checking, tightening, adjusting, lubrication, oil changes, engine tune-ups, fuel-system adjustments, wheel alignment and balancing, cleaning, replenishment of fuel, engine oil, transaxle fluid, brake fluid, clutch fluid, power steering fluid, battery electrolyte fluid, anti-freeze coolant, windshield washer fluid, air-conditioner refrigerant and tire rotation, unless such services are performed as part of a covered warrantable repair.

blocks.heading: Normal deterioration or wear of any part, including:
items: Spark Plugs
Worn brake pads / Linings
Worn clutch linings / Discs
Wiper Blades
Filters
Bulb and Fuses
V-Belts
Other wear and consumable items

blocks.text: Any vehicle where the odometer mileage has been altered.

Any vehicle that has ever been declared a total loss, scrapped, or issued a “salvage” or similar title or certificate under any applicable law. This includes but is not limited to vehicles that are currently or were previously titled as “scrap”, “rebuilt”, or “dismantled”.

blocks.heading: Consequential damages and failure resulting directly or indirectly from any of the following:
items: Negligence of proper maintenance as required in the Owner’s Manual. (Recommended Periodic maintenance not carried out timely from authorized Hyundai dealership).
Misuse, abuse, overload, accident, theft, water flooding or fire.
Use of improper or insufficient fuel, fluids, or lubricants.
Use of parts other than Hyundai Genuine Parts or parts of non-equivalent quality and design.
Any device and/or accessories not supplied by Hyundai.
Modification, alteration, tampering, or improper repair.
Water contamination.
Deterioration of rubber parts, upholstery, and soft trim under normal use and exposure.
Slight Irregularities not recognized as affecting the quality of the function of the vehicle or parts, such as slight noise or vibration, or items considered characteristic of the vehicle.

blocks.heading: Battery:
blocks.text:
Standard 12 Volt Battery (except HEV)
(See separate battery manufacturer’s warranty)

Incidental or consequential damages associated with a vehicle failure, including without limitation loss of time, inconvenience, cost of transportation, fuel, travel, rental expense, storage charges, telephone calls, food & lodging, loss of personal or commercial property, loss of pay or revenue, and loss of use of the vehicle, are not covered under this warranty.

blocks.heading: Others:
items: Airborne “fallout”, industrial fall-out, acid rain, salt, hail, sand storm, and other Acts of God.
Paint scratches, dents, or similar paint or body damage.
Action of road elements (sand, gravel, dust, or road debris) that result in stone chipping of paint and glass.
Any paint defects or problems arising out of the cargo compartment. (Trucks only)
Rodents or any other damage not resulting from defects in materials or workmanship.

Proper use, periodic maintenance, and care of your vehicle in accordance with the instructions contained in your Owner’s Manual. (If your vehicle is subject to use under severe driving conditions, you should follow the maintenance requirements specified accordingly in your Owner’s Manual).
Retain maintenance service records, it may be necessary for you to show that this required maintenance has been performed, as specified in the Owner’s Manual.
Deliver the vehicle during regular service business hours to any authorized Hyundai Dealer to obtain warranty service.
Check for trim, paint, or other appearance concerns at the time the new vehicle is delivered.

sections.title: Hyundai hybrid system limited warranty (if applicable)

blocks.heading: What is covered
blocks.text: Repair or replacement of Hybrid System components listed below, originally manufactured or installed by Hyundai, that are found to be defective in material or factory workmanship under normal use and maintenance, except any items specifically referred to in the section “What is not covered”.

blocks.heading: Warranty period
blocks.text: The Warranty period for the following Hybrid System components is limited to 4 years from the date of original retail delivery or date of first use or 100,000 km, whichever occurs first.

blocks.heading: Hybrid system
items: Hybrid Starter & Generator
Hybrid Power Control Unit
Traction Motor

blocks.heading: High voltage battery
blocks.text: High voltage battery capacity warranty coverage period for a hybrid vehicle is 8 years from the date of retail delivery or date of first use, or 160,000 km, whichever occurs first.

blocks.heading: Owner’s responsibilities
blocks.text: Your responsibilities are the same as those described in Hyundai New Vehicle Limited Warranty.

blocks.heading: What is not covered
blocks.text: Items not covered by this warranty and any exclusion or limitations relating to this warranty are the same as those set forth in the “What is not covered” section of the Hyundai New Vehicle Limited Warranty already described in this handbook.

The High Voltage Battery will experience gradual energy or power loss with time and use. Loss of battery energy or power over time or due to or resulting from battery usage is NOT covered under this Hybrid System Limited Warranty. Damage to the battery resulting from the following activities is also not covered under this Hybrid System Limited Warranty:
items: Physically damaging the battery, intentionally or unintentionally attempting, either by physical means, programming, or other methods, to change/alter/extend (other than as specified in the Owner’s Manual provided with the Vehicle at the time of first retail purchase) or reduce the life of the battery.
Exposing the battery to direct flame (excluding battery fires as specified above) or any other external element/factor.
Incidental & consequential damages not covered in warranty are the same as those described in the ‘What is not covered in warranty section’.
